newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London flat ahead of FOMC outcome.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London flat ahead of FOMC outcome.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were flat in a quiet market on Tuesday as investors sat on their hands awaiting the outcome of a policy meeting of the U.S. FOMC.
"Everyone's waiting for the outcome of the meeting, just in case," one trader said. "It's killing the market."
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 97.36 points at 13,548.43 by 1550 GMT.
"I don't think anyone wants to buy ahead of the meeting and not be able to clear their positions until after the Chinese New Year," another said.
The U.S. Federal Reserve's policy making body was largely expected to leave interest rates unchanged but investors were cautious all the same, traders said.
HSBC Holdings was the only stock investors showed any real interest in buying, traders said. HSBC was up HK$1.5 to HK$182 by 1530 GMT.
Market volume was weak, traders said, with the market closed on Thurday and Friday for the Chinese New Year and many investors taking extended holidays.
